perspective:
From Ethan Mohamud’s available perspective:

- He is a plumber and has a long-time close friendship with Gary Guo; they met in middle school, and Gary is a doctor.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. He became concerned.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation. He told Gary that his health was just as important, that he hated seeing him like this, and that two days might give him a new perspective.
- Ethan heard Gary initially say he appreciated the concern but couldn’t go because there was too much to do at the hospital. Later, Ethan was at the retreat with Gary.
- During the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work. Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than just professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, saying they had been friends since middle school, that Gary could tell him anything, and that he was there to help, not judge.
- Ethan heard Gary say it was complicated and that he didn’t want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- Gary then opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing. Ethan felt relief and empathy and offered to help Gary find better balance.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities. Gary agreed and said he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary, discussed his progress and challenges, saw Gary making efforts to change, and felt hopeful and proud. Ethan told Gary he was proud of his progress and was available whenever he needed to talk.
- Ethan heard Gary say things were better, that he was less overwhelmed thanks to Ethan’s help, and that he had time for a movie the previous weekend.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary as capable of managing on his own with a healthier work-life balance. Ethan felt satisfied and happy for him and decided to step back.
- Ethan told Gary he was always just a call away, that he knew Gary had this, and to keep up the great work. He heard Gary thank him, say he couldn’t have done it without his support, and that he felt more in control now.
